name: jwlv4lgtvwebos
description: JW Vídeos para TV LG webOS

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && cp webos/appinfo.json webos/icon.png webos/largeIcon.png webos/splash.png dist/
scripts.tv: npm run build && rm -rf ipk && ares-package dist -o ipk && ares-install --device tv ipk/*.ipk && ares-launch --device tv com.jwlv4lgtvwebos.app
